## Summary

**Classification:** `timing_difference` (deposit in transit)

**Key evidence:**
- **GL-0124** — ledger inflow of USD 9,634.25 from Arnold Ltd for INV-1061, posted 2026-08-31.
- **No bank line** carries reference INV-1061 (0 bank transactions found), and the reference isn't matched elsewhere.
- **DOC-024** (customer invoice) — amount due USD 9,634.25, confirming the ledger amount is correct.
- **DOC-031** (remittance advice, 2026-08-31) — ACH initiated 2026-08-31, 1–2 business days to settle, i.e. after the 2026-08-31 statement cut-off.

**Proposed fix:** No correcting entry — an empty journal entry was proposed. The ledger already records the receipt at the right amount and date; the gap is purely that the ACH had not settled by the statement end date. The item should be shown as an outstanding deposit on the August bank reconciliation and confirmed as cleared on the September statement.

This is a proposal only (PROP-3887F310, pending human approval) — nothing has been posted.
